# Open URL / settings page (`open`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Apps & scripts · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** no

Opens a website, a file, a folder, or a Windows Settings page (ms-settings: links).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | text | yes |  | What to open. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: open
    target: https://calendar.google.com
```
